name: EARLY EDUCATION DEVICE KIDS READING AND LEARNING DEVICE EDUCATIONAL TOY ( Random Cololur )
description:
Looking for an engaging early learning toy for your child?
Our Interactive Flash Card Learning Machine is designed to help children between 2–6 years old learn words in a fun and interactive way. Simply insert a flash card, and the machine will pronounce the word printed on the card – making learning both exciting and effective.

✨ Why Kids Will Love It:

Interactive Learning with Sound & Images – Realistic animal and vehicle sounds (some cards without sound), cute pictures, and automatic pronunciation attract kids’ attention and spark their interest in learning.

Eye Protection & Screen-Free – No screens, no internet needed. This device keeps children away from phones, TVs, and tablets while protecting their eyesight.

Portable & Rechargeable – Lightweight and compact, easy to carry anywhere. Just turn it on, insert a card, and it will read the word aloud. Repeat function helps kids remember better.

Safe & Durable Design – Made with smooth, high-quality plastic with rounded edges for safe play.

Perfect Gift Idea – A wonderful educational toy for birthdays, Children’s Day, Christmas, Easter, Halloween, Thanksgiving, New Year, or any special occasion.

📦 Package Includes:

1 x Flash Card Machine (English version)

112 Cards (224 words in English, sent randomly)

1 x USB Charging Cable

🔋 Specifications:

Material: High-quality plastic

Color Options: Blue / Pink

Age Range: 3+ years

Battery: Built-in rechargeable battery

Charging: USB

Size: 10.5 × 8.5 × 1.5 cm

💡 Warm Tips:

If you receive a damaged item or face any issues, please contact us before leaving feedback. We’ll resolve your problem as quickly as possible.

Manual measurement may have a slight 1–2 cm error.

Make learning fun, interactive, and screen-free with this amazing early learning toy!
